result.summary: Found 1 major visual layout issue in the popular restaurant card metadata.

issues.description: The metadata beneath “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” is overlapping: the delivery-time text (“25–35 min”) collides with the “€0 delivery” label, making both pieces of information difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine as separate horizontally spaced elements (or wrap them onto a second line) with sufficient width and spacing to prevent text overlap.
